prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE seamless horizontal flat unwrapped UV ground path overlay strip for a medieval southern England 1300 painterly isometric strategy game. Left and right edges must tile continuously, same color and path width. Summer. Soft upper-left lighting, restrained contact depth only. No people, stones larger than gravel, signs, buildings, forks, corner, text, watermark, black background or checkerboard. Reference image is material palette only, NOT composition.
postprocess: Summer crop shared with corresponding winter; one resize to512x48; Y8 transparent +8 inward fade; X24 endpoint blend; zero RGB at alpha0; no mirrors/rotations
